column1: # UNGRADABLE.tsv -- aisnobol: the lockdown bucket. MIRRORS OUTSIDE_SPITBOL_BASELINE.tsv row for row; the
# runner compares the two every run and says so aloud when they drift. That file is THE RECORD and carries the
# source check; this one keeps the four inventory numbers summing to shipped. Edit them together.
# Written coo 2026-09-08 from the live-measured record.
# Every reason here is ORACLE-SIDE ONLY: lib_inventory.sh refuses a reason naming our own compiler, and it
# reads the whole file including comments.
# ⛔ A QUOTED SOURCE LINE MUST NOT CARRY A LITERAL TAB -- SNOBOL4 source is label<TAB>statement, and pasting it
# raw into a TSV splits the row into four fields. Tabs in quoted source are collapsed to spaces here.

column3: does not run in SPITBOL: ERROR 022 -- undefined function called, BUILDLIB.sno(21), a graceful fatal report at rc=0; source checked 2026-09-08 (coo): stmt 21 `LOOP FILE_POS = SET(1,0,1)` -- the program calls SET(), a function SPITBOL does not define. This is a feature another implementation provides and ours does not need to reproduce, so it is outside the baseline rather than a defect.

does not run in SPITBOL as a program: sbl -bf answers `No END statement found in source file(s).`, SPITCORE.sno; source checked 2026-09-08 (coo): the file is 917 lines opening `* SPITCORE.SPT - SPITBOL-68K VERSION` and carries no END statement anywhere -- it is a library core meant to be included, not a program meant to be run. Not an ORACLE_REFUSES: the oracle behaves correctly and the file simply is not a program.
